Everygame Sportsbook launched in 1983 as Intertops and revolutionized sports betting in 1996 when the site took the first online wager in history. Everygame Sportsbook was also the first site to offer a sportsbook platform for mobile devices in 2000. Many more online sportsbooks have come and gone since then, but few providers can match the experience and quality of Everygame Sportsbook.

Everygame Sportsbook Welcome Bonus: Up to $1000 for New Players

Everygame Sportsbook offers a premium welcome promotion for Betting News readers that delivers real value right from the start. By using the “WELCOME1000″ code, U.S. players can claim a 100% deposit match up to $500. The best part of this Everygame Sportsbook welcome bonus is that it can be used twice per customer, unlocking up to $1,000 in total bonus bucks.

To take advantage of the offer, players simply need to make a minimum deposit of $50 using any eligible non-crypto payment method and enter the bonus code immediately after funding their account and before placing any wagers. The promotion is valid for 60 days from sign-up, giving players plenty of flexibility to time their redemptions and maximize value.

Once activated, players must complete a 12x rollover requirement on the combined deposit and bonus amount. Minimum odds of -200 are required for qualifying wagers. Up to $500 per bet counts toward rollover completion, which gives players the chance to work through the requirement efficiently. Do note that horse racing wagers and boosted odds bets are excluded from rollover play.

As with most sportsbook promotions, only one bonus code can be active at a time. Also, bonus funds are restricted to sportsbook use only and cannot be transferred for play at either of the Everygame Casino platforms.

Also, for those who prefer to use cryptocurrency for online gambling, there is a special crypto-only welcome offer. You will get a smaller amount on your first deposit than with the non-crypto welcome offer, as it is a 50% bonus up to $100. But this offer is redeemable up to 10 times for new players, so you can still get the same total amount in bonuses, just across more deposits.

What Are Everygame Sportsbook’s Features?

Everygame Sportsbook has stayed ahead of the game for nearly three decades. It now features a newly-designed site that runs smoothly and keeps players returning because of its outstanding user experience.

The site is optimized for play on mobile devices and is a better option than the desktop version because of its live betting interface and ease of use.

You can easily find anything you want with just a few clicks or screen taps.

Everygame has an in-play betting feature easily accessed from the main menu. You will also find a calendar displaying all upcoming games with live betting.

At Everygame, you can bet on this week’s NFL odds, make MLB betting picks daily, wager on today’s NBA matchups, and much, much more, and many events are available for both pre-game and in-game betting.

What Betting Options Are Available at Everygame Sportsbook in 2026?

You can wager on all major North American sports markets and international events, including English Premier League odds, UEFA Champions League lines, cricket, Aussie rules, and rugby. Here are the current sports markets available at Everygame Sportsbook:

  • NFL
  • NBA
  • NHL
  • MLB
  • NCAA Football
  • NCAA Basketball
  • Soccer
  • Tennis

  • Boxing

  • Handball
  • Motorsports (Formula 1, NASCAR, and more)
  • Politics
  • Rugby
  • Snooker
  • Stock Market
  • Table Tennis

What Are Everygame Sportsbook’s Other Bonuses and Promotions?

Everygame Sportsbook consistently offers seasonal sportsbook promotions and monthly contests that give players added value throughout the year.

In addition to soccer promotions, Everygame runs monthly leaderboard-style contests for active bettors. The $1000 Live Legend promotion rewards the most profitable live bettor of the month with a $400 cash prize, while additional prizes are paid out to the top 10 finishers.

The $1000 Parlay Prince promotion awards a $1,000 bonus to the player with the highest net profit from a single parlay wager during the month, while the $500 Odds Hunter rewards the customer who cashes the winning parlay with the highest combined odds.

One of the best parts about these recurring promotions is that many of the prizes come without rollover requirements, giving players more flexibility with their winnings.

Does Everygame Sportsbook Have a Rewards Program?

Everygame Sportsbook does not have a traditional, tiered VIP loyalty program. However, they offer a steady stream of “recurring rewards” and a point system for their other products that often cross over.

What Banking Options are Available at Everygame Sportsbook in 2026?

If you sign up at Everygame Sportsbook, you will have access to several convenient banking methods that make it easy to deposit and withdraw no matter where you’re located:

Cryptocurrency – Deposits using Bitcoin, Bitcoin Cash, Lightning Bitcoin, and Litecoin deposits up to $2,500, and withdrawals of $25 and up are available. Payouts are typically processed within 48 hours.

Credit/Debit Cards – VISA and MasterCard, American Express, and Discover debit, credit, and gift cards are accepted for deposits of $20 to $1,000 instantly. Withdrawals to a credit or debit card are not available.

Bank transfer – Bank wire transfers are available with no withdrawal amount limits. Payouts usually take 2-3 business days. This payment method is only available for withdrawals, not deposits.

Check by Courier – A paper check can be delivered by courier service in amounts between $15 and $3,000, with up to five business days for processing. This method is also only available for withdrawals.

Non-U.S. players have other methods for deposits and withdrawals, such as BetterEFT, PaysafeCard, eZeeWallet, and Neosurf.

What Customer Support is Available at Everygame Sportsbook?

Everygame is known in the online gaming industry for its excellent customer support. Support can be reached via live chat, email, or phone, and you can also use the form provided on the “Contact Us” page to request a response to your inquiry.

Also, with their long history in a volatile industry, you can count on Everygame to meet an exceptional level of service while guaranteeing your personal and financial information is protected. The Curacao Gaming Authority licenses Everygame Sportsbook, and the site uses security features like SSL encryption to protect every online transaction.

Conclusion: Should You Play at Everygame Sportsbook?

Everygame Sportsbook has solidified its place as one of the most trusted and innovative online betting platforms.

With a history dating back decades and a track record of firsts in the industry, Everygame continues to provide a high-quality experience for bettors. Its user-friendly interface, mobile-optimized platform, and strong lineup of promotions make it a great choice for both new and experienced bettors.

Whether you’re looking to take advantage of its generous welcome bonuses, enjoy exciting seasonal or ongoing promotions, or explore its extensive betting markets, Everygame offers plenty of value.

With fast payouts, multiple banking options, and top-notch customer support, it remains a reliable option for online sports betting for U.S. players. If you are in search of a sportsbook with a proven history and a commitment to player satisfaction, Everygame Sportsbook is well worth considering.

Everygame Sportsbook FAQ

Is Everygame Sportsbook a trustworthy betting site?
Yes, Everygame Sportsbook has been in operation since 1983 and was the first online sportsbook to accept an internet wager in 1996. The Curacao Gaming Authority licensed this sportsbook, and uses SSL encryption to protect transactions, ensuring a secure and reputable betting experience.
Is Everygame a legal sportsbook?
Yes. It’s also one of the top sportsbook sites in the U.S. market. Check your local betting laws to see if Everygame is available in your state.
What promotions does Everygame Sportsbook offer?
Everygame Sportsbook offers a strong welcome bonus for Betting News readers, which provides a 100% deposit match up to $500 twice. Also, the sportsbook runs regular seasonal and event-based promos such as UEFA Champions League and FIFA World Cup stake-back offers, as well as monthly contests that reward top live bettors and parlay players with cash prizes and bonuses.
How fast are payouts at Everygame Sportsbook?
Payout speeds vary by withdrawal method. They typically process cryptocurrency withdrawals within 48 hours. Bank transfers take 2-3 business days, while check-by-courier withdrawals may take up to five business days.
What sports can I bet on at Everygame Sportsbook?
Everygame covers a wide range of sports. This includes the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLB, college football and basketball, soccer, tennis, MMA, golf, and more. International markets like rugby, cricket, and esports are also available.
Does Everygame Sportsbook have live betting?
Yes, Everygame offers an in-play betting feature, allowing users to place wagers on live games.
